headlines.description: — Viktor Arvidsson had three goals including two empty-netters, Elias Lindholm scored a tiebreaking, power-play goal 13 seconds into the third period and the Boston Bruins helped their playoff push with a 6-3 win over the Dallas Stars on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Viktor Arvidsson scores three goals, Elias Lindholm gets tiebreaker in Bruins' 6-3 win over Stars

events.name: New York Islanders at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Bowen Byram flipped a long shot into an empty net with 1:43 remaining to lead the Buffalo Sabres to a 4-3 victory over the New York Islanders on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Byram's empty-netter stands as winner to lift Sabres past Islanders 4-3

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Jakub Dobes stopped 36 shots and the Montreal Canadiens won their sixth straight game, beating the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canadiens extend winning streak to 6 games with a 4-1 win over the Lightning

headlines.description: — Noah Gregor scored eight seconds into the game to open an early five-goal barrage by Florida, Matthew Tkachuk had his first four-point game since December 2024 and the Panthers defeated the Ottawa Senators 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matthew Tkachuk has goal and 3 assists, Panthers strike fast and top Senators 6-3

events.name: New Jersey Devils at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Conor Sheary and J.T. Miller scored first-period goals and Igor Shesterkin made 22 saves as the New York Rangers defeated the New Jersey Devils 4-1 on Tuesday night
headlines.shortLinkText: Shesterkin stops 22, fights Markstrom as Rangers down Devils 4-1

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Egor Chinakov had a goal and an assist, Evgeni Malkin added an assist in his return to the lineup and the Pittsburgh Penguins raced past the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Malkin collects career point 1,399 in return from injury, Penguins race by reeling Red Wings 5-1

headlines.description: — Alex Ovechkin scored twice and hit the 30-goal mark for the 20th time in his NHL career, and the Washington Capitals beat the Philadelphia Flyers 6-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Ovechkin scores twice, hitting 30 goals for 20th season, as Capitals beat Flyers 6-4

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Nikolaj Ehlers scored the go-ahead goal with 7:18 remaining and the Carolina Hurricanes reached the 100-point mark for the fifth time in franchise history, defeating the reeling Columbus Blue Jackets 5-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carolina reaches 100-point mark and stays atop East with 5-2 victory over Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Kyle Connor scored 33 seconds into overtime to lead the Winnipeg Jets to a 4-3 win over the Chicago Blackhawks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor scores OT goal as Jets defeat Blackhawks 4-3

headlines.description: — Connor Ingram celebrated his 29th birthday Tuesday by making 27 saves for his second shutout of the season as the Edmonton Oilers extended their winning streak to four games by beating the Seattle Kraken 3-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers’ Ingram celebrates birthday with 27-save shutout, 3-0 win against Kraken
